command.help.public:
Available commands:
/new        start a new session (archive current)
/reset      clear the current session
/forget     clear the session and long-term memory
/status     show agent and session status
/ping       connectivity check
/help       show this help

Personas:
/persona            show the active persona
/persona list       list available personas
/persona <name>     switch persona
/persona reset      revert to the default persona
/persona create <name>
/persona delete <name>
/persona export <name>
/persona import <name> <json>

Skills:
/skills     list enabled skills

In a room (owner only):
/mode mention|all   change how the bot responds
command.help.admin:
Developer commands (administrators only):
/debug      configuration summary with secrets redacted
/context    context-window usage
/history    recent transcript events
/tier       show the active model tier
/usage      token usage for this session

Rooms:
/join <room> [nick] [mention|all]   join a public room
/leave [room]                       leave a room
/rooms                              list active rooms
/mode mention|all                   room owner: change how the bot responds

Ignore list:
/ignore <jid|domain|nick:Name>      silently ignore a sender
/unignore <jid|domain|nick:Name>    remove from the ignore list
/ignore                             show the ignore list
